A thick fog rolls over a crooked graveyard at midnight.
You wander into a pumpkin patch where every jack-o'-lantern seems to be watching you.
Lightning flashes over a castle laboratory high in the mountains.
The gates of an abandoned asylum creak open on their own.
A black cat crosses your path on a moonlit country road.
The full moon rises over a dark forest, and something howls in the distance.
Candles flicker in the windows of a Victorian manor that has been empty for a hundred years.
You stumble into a cornfield maze and lose sight of the exit.
The crypt beneath the old chapel smells of damp earth and dead roses.
Children in costumes stream down the street, bags full of candy.
A haunted hayride rattles past, its passengers suspiciously quiet.
The bridge over the creek in Sleepy Hollow groans under your weight.
Torches line the corridors of a Transylvanian castle.
A cauldron bubbles in a clearing, and nobody seems to be tending it.
The sarcophagus in the museum's Egyptian wing has been opened.
Mist curls across the black waters of a lagoon deep in the Amazon.
Organ music drifts up from the catacombs beneath the Paris Opera House.
A costume party is in full swing, but some of the guests aren't wearing costumes.
The porch light of the last house on the street flickers and dies.
Dead leaves skitter across a churchyard as the bell tolls thirteen.
A coffin lies open in the cellar of an old inn.
The moors are silent except for a low growl somewhere in the mist.
A fortune teller's tent glows at the edge of a deserted carnival.
Villagers with pitchforks and torches march up the hill toward the castle.
The wind whistles through the rafters of a barn with a scarecrow nailed to its door.
Bats pour out of a bell tower as the sun goes down.
A candy bowl on an empty porch has a sign that reads 'TAKE ONE'.
The last train of the night pulls into a station that isn't on any map.
You hear chains dragging across the floor of the attic above you.
It's All Hallows' Eve, and the veil between worlds is at its thinnest.
